summary: Returns TRUE when FlagBitTest(2) is set and FlagBitTest(4) is clear. Two independent flag-bit queries are combined with a logical AND of the first test and the negation of the second; the meaning of flag bits 2 and 4 is unresolved.

operations.description: FlagBitTest(2) queries the state of flag bit 2; the result must be set for the function to return TRUE.
FlagBitTest(4) queries the state of flag bit 4; the result must be clear for the function to return TRUE.
The two flag queries are combined as FlagBitTest(2) AND NOT FlagBitTest(4).
Returns TRUE only if flag bit 2 is set and flag bit 4 is clear, otherwise FALSE.

unresolved: Semantics of flag bits 2 and 4 in the store that FlagBitTest reads.
Which global flag store FlagBitTest operates on.
Callers InputCommandDispatchToEntities and TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing suggest an input/team-radio gating role, but this is not evidenced.
